title: Flaky: VS Code extension E2E (browser-debugger) times out waiting for pwa-msedge child debug session to attach to Blazor WASM
test_name: VS Code extension E2E (matrix shards, e.g. browser-debugger / workspace-target-proof / edge-cases)
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Failed to apply E2E control revision ...: Error: Timed out after 279542ms waiting for pwa-msedge child session for Blazor WASM root '<guid>'. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"id":"...","type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger", ...}]}
analysis: The 'Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for standalone' test timed out after ~279s waiting for the pwa-msedge child debugger session to attach to a Blazor WASM root. This is unrelated to the PR's change (a cloud icon addition in AzureEnvironmentResourceExtensions.cs), and matches a previously observed, recurring flaky pattern of VS Code extension E2E browser-debugger tests timing out waiting for the child debug session under Windows CI load.
